summary: The four actor sheets are a unified shell at base+template level: all extend SWSEV2ActorSheetBase (ShellHost mixin, one PARTS template that branches by actor mode); character/npc/droid share SWSEV2CharacterLikeSheet, vehicle is a base sibling with three verbatim helper clones. Real problems: sheet credit edits bypass TransactionEngine; UI preferences persisted as actor flags from two writers; presentation computes Second Wind, defense subtotals and a second prerequisite evaluator; 5 raw gameplay chat sites; character-like-sheet.js is 8,737 lines; global render listeners use V1 hook names (suspected no-op on V2) plus post-render DOM repair listeners; legacy floating apps (gm-store-dashboard, combat-action-browser) remain live alongside Holopad/GM Datapad surfaces.

findings.title: Sheet credit edits bypass TransactionEngine
findings.observed: The Add Credits button computes next=max(0,current+amount) and writes system.credits with ActorEngine.updateActor; several templates expose name=system.credits inputs submitted through the sheet form path. TransactionEngine.executeCreditAdjustment exists but is not used. No ledger entry; status feed only.
findings.intendedOwnership: A-10: TransactionEngine is the single credit authority; sheet emits a credit-adjustment intent.
findings.proposedSolution: Route the button and form credit field through TransactionEngine.executeCreditAdjustment (source 'sheet-manual-adjustment'); make the field read-only or intercept it in the form coercion path. Owner decides who may adjust (GM-only vs owner).
findings.alternatives: Keep manual edit as a documented GM-only exception.
findings.regressionTests: Test that sheet adjustments create a TransactionEngine ledger record and that form submit of system.credits is refused or rerouted.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: player and GM adjust credits from summary/gear tab.

findings.title: Vehicle sheet duplicates three shell helpers verbatim
findings.observed: buildSheetActionEconomyContext (696 tokens), sanitizeSheetRenderContext (559+520), documentToTemplateData (302) and helpers are exact clones; the disclosure comment names a stale file.
findings.intendedOwnership: One pure module shared by all actor sheets.
findings.proposedSolution: Move the pure functions to scripts/sheets/v2/shared/sheet-render-context.js and import from both sheets (no Vehicle->Character dependency).
findings.alternatives: Hoist onto SWSEV2ActorSheetBase as static helpers.
findings.regressionTests: Unit test of the shared module; tests/phase4-sheet-architecture-contract.test.mjs.
findings.simplificationBenefit: ~1,500 duplicate tokens removed; one sanitizer to fix.

findings.title: UI preferences persisted as actor flags by direct setFlag from two writers
findings.observed: sheetTheme / sheetMotionStyle are written by both the sheet theme control and the Settings surface; help level by HelpModeManager; all direct actor.setFlag/unsetFlag outside ActorEngine. Each write triggers updateActor and a full sheet rerender for UI-only state.
findings.intendedOwnership: OSI: UI-only state must not require actor updates; A-02 for any actor write.
findings.proposedSolution: Owner decides storage: client setting/user flag (preferred, no actor rerender) or keep per-actor flag via one ActorEngine.updateActorFlags helper used by both writers.
findings.alternatives: localStorage keyed by actor id (as setStoredSheetMode).
findings.regressionTests: Test: changing theme does not call actor.update and re-applies on next render.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: theme change on owned and observer-permission actors.
findings.simplificationBenefit: One preference writer; fewer full rerenders.
findings.risk: Low; observers without update permission currently fail.

findings.title: Gameplay chat cards via raw ChatMessage.create in sheet/shell
findings.observed: Reload notices, a sheet card helper, beast level-up request and Atlas GM notice post directly. SWSEChat is already imported by character-like-sheet.
findings.proposedSolution: Replace with SWSEChat.postMessage (or equivalent) preserving speaker/whisper.
findings.regressionTests: Probe P-A05 shows 0 hits in ui-shell.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Chat card rendering of reload and Atlas notices.

findings.title: Presentation recomputes Second Wind and defense values
findings.observed: buildSecondWindPanel computes max(floor(HP/4), CON) with its own CON fallback and max uses default 1, ignoring SecondWindRules healing modes, multipliers, feat rules and house-rule use counts. The defense tooltip rebuilds a subtotal and uses it as the total when derived total is falsy, and selects Fort ability by actor type.
findings.intendedOwnership: SecondWindRules / DefenseCalculator compute; panels display derived values.
findings.proposedSolution: Expose SecondWindRules.calculateHealingAmount/calculateMaxUses results in derived data (or call them from the builder); tooltip shows derived total and breakdown terms only, with 'unavailable' when absent.
findings.regressionTests: Test with secondWindWebEnhancement house rule: panel shows engine values.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Second Wind panel with house rules toggled.

findings.title: Second prerequisite evaluator in the item dialog
findings.observed: The entity dialog evaluates ability/BAB/level/class/feat/talent clauses with its own evaluator; progression uses prerequisite-evaluator.js. Both live; results can disagree.
findings.intendedOwnership: Progression prerequisite authority evaluates; dialog displays.
findings.proposedSolution: Have the dialog call the progression evaluator (adapter for its clause shape); keep normalizePrereqClauses as the editor normalizer only.
findings.regressionTests: Parity test: same clauses/actor give the same met/unmet in both.

findings.title: Legacy floating apps beside Holopad/GM Datapad
findings.observed: gm-store-dashboard is registered as a GM settings menu while GM Datapad has a Store governance surface and shares cloned approval logic (class B: deprecated but referenced). combat-action-browser adds a Token HUD button opening a separate window (class B, F: runtime risk on roll integration); its sidebar button is commented out. The Action Palette module is gone; CSS selector and an audit path remain (class C).
findings.intendedOwnership: OSI: Holopad/Shell Host and GM Datapad replace older floating UIs.
findings.proposedSolution: Reroute the settings menu to open GMDatapad on the store surface, then retire gm-store-dashboard (+css/hbs, update ti4c0-g21/g24 tests). Owner decides whether the Token HUD combat browser stays; if retired, point HUD to the sheet combat tab. Delete Action Palette remnants.
findings.alternatives: Keep gm-store-dashboard as a GM fallback until Datapad parity is accepted live.
findings.regressionTests: Tests asserting no registerMenu for GMStoreDashboard and no renderTokenHUD browser button after retirement.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: GM store governance via Datapad; Token HUD actions.

findings.title: character-like-sheet.js mixes ~123 listeners, context assembly and rule dispatch
findings.observed: 8,737 lines / 6,764 SLOC, 81+ imports spanning combat, force, talents, store, progression, mentor; 4 transitive CI tests.
findings.intendedOwnership: Per-tab controllers (character-sheet/*-ui.js already exist for some tabs) bound by the shell; class keeps lifecycle only.
findings.proposedSolution: Extract seams already implied by data-action groups: force-suite actions, starship-suite actions, credits/resources, item add/create, reconciliation; each a controller module with bind(sheet, root, signal). No behavior change; move with tests per seam.
findings.regressionTests: Listener inventory test (dev/sheet-action-registry.mjs) unchanged before/after each extraction.

findings.title: Unreferenced templates and stylesheets; two live apps' CSS never loaded
findings.observed: reachability.json: 43 unreferenced .hbs, 67 unreferenced .css. Sample of 14 templates verified by partial-name search across scripts/templates/system.json: no inbound reference (hits were class names or sibling files). combat-action-browser.css and gm-store-dashboard.css are not in system.json nor imported, so their live apps render without them. styles/shell/home-surface.css differs from loaded styles/system/home-surface.css.
findings.proposedSolution: Class F batch: verify dynamically composed partial names (grep `{{> (concat` / template string builders) then delete unreferenced files with their CSS; decide per F-UIS-007 whether the two app CSS files are added to system.json or deleted with the apps.
findings.regressionTests: A template-reference test that fails on new unreferenced .hbs.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Visual check of combat browser and store dashboard.
findings.risk: Low; dynamic partial names are the risk.

findings.title: Global render listeners: V1 hook names on V2 apps and post-render DOM repair
findings.observed: Discovery and the responsive observer listen to renderApplication/renderActorSheet/renderItemSheet; Foundry V13 ApplicationV2 fires render<ClassName> hooks for its own inheritance chain (renderActorSheetV2, renderApplicationV2), so these probably never fire for SWSE V2 sheets (suspected; unverified live). Eight live renderApplicationV2 listeners in force/patch modules run DOM repair on every app render of any kind.
findings.intendedOwnership: Sheets bind their own tooltip/observer in _onRender; no post-render global repairs (A-09).
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument: count hook invocations per render in a live world. Replace V1 hook names with renderApplicationV2 or direct calls from SWSEV2ActorSheetBase._onRender; fold repair logic into the owning sheet render (B-CPT compat-patches owns hotfix retirement).
findings.regressionTests: Hook-name contract test listing allowed global render hooks.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: confirm whether discovery tooltips bind on V2 sheets; measure render time with listeners disabled.

findings.title: Unreachable UI modules
findings.observed: 44 orphan/importers-only modules (~6.5k SLOC). Basename grep across scripts, templates, index.js, system.json and packs/*.db found no runtime reference (hits were word collisions or other unreachable modules). Clusters: dev diagnostics harnesses (class C or move to tools/), V1 bases (BaseAppV2 extends Application, CR-09; class C), UI components never wired (C), duplicate drop/modal/mobile helpers superseded by live ones (C).
findings.proposedSolution: Delete class C clusters in one change per cluster; move any wanted diagnostics into tools/ or tests/.
findings.alternatives: Keep diagnostics behind a dev flag with an importer.
findings.regressionTests: Census --check shows the files absent and no new orphans.

findings.title: World-document creates in UI (legitimate exceptions lacking comments)
findings.observed: Actor.createDocuments / Actor.create / Item.create / actor.delete of world documents (new ally actor, GM contact actor + orphan cleanup, world item, compendium import). Not actor-owned: A-02 exception applies but no exception comment. Probe line character-like-sheet:5332 is a false positive (Set.delete).
findings.intendedOwnership: A-02 world-document exception with code comment.
findings.proposedSolution: Add the exception comment at each site; consider one WorldDocumentFactory for actor creation from UI.

findings.title: Explicit full render after actor mutations (double render hypothesis)
findings.observed: 11 handlers call this.render(false|true) right after an ActorEngine write that already re-renders the sheet via updateActor.
findings.proposedSolution: Instrument render counts per click; replace with mutateAndRepaint or drop the explicit render.
findings.regressionTests: Render-count test with a stub actor.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Halves renders on those actions if confirmed.
